# Boston College Center for Corporate Citizenship

> BCCCC is a leading resource hub for corporate social responsibility and ESG practices, supporting 400+ global members in advancing sustainable and inclusive business practices.

The Boston College Center for Corporate Citizenship (BCCCC) provides research, benchmarking tools, and networking opportunities for companies committed to corporate citizenship. As part of Boston College's Carroll School of Management, BCCCC offers advisory boards, member resources, and annual recognition programs like the Innovation Awards.

## Key Topics

- Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR)
- Environmental Sustainability (ESG)
- ESG Reporting & Disclosure
- Diversity & Inclusion
- Community Involvement
- Employee Engagement & Volunteering
- Benchmarking & Best Practices
- Corporate Citizenship
- Membership Benefits
- Innovation Awards
- Vendor Responsibility
- Sustainability Trends
- Non-Financial Disclosure
- Employee Giving Programs

## About BCCCC

- [Boston College Center for Corporate Citizenship](https://ccc.bc.edu): BCCCC homepage showcasing corporate citizenship resources, awards, and reports.
- [About Boston College Center for Corporate Citizenship](https://ccc.bc.edu/content/bc-ccc/about.html): BCCCC mission and purpose supporting corporate social responsibility efforts.
- [Mission & History](https://ccc.bc.edu/content/bc-ccc/about/mission-history.html): BCCCC mission statement, history, and ESG sustainability leadership timeline.
- [Meet Our Team](https://ccc.bc.edu/content/bc-ccc/about/team.html): BCCCC leadership team and staff directory with professional bios.

## Membership & Community

- [Why Join?](https://ccc.bc.edu/content/bc-ccc/why-join.html): BCCCC membership benefits and professional growth opportunities.
- [Membership Benefits](https://ccc.bc.edu/content/bc-ccc/why-join/membership-benefits.html): BCCCC member resources, reports, and ESG tools for corporate citizenship.
- [Become a Member](https://ccc.bc.edu/content/bc-ccc/why-join/become-a-member.html): BCCCC membership application and eligibility for CSR/ESG professionals.
- [Meet Our Members](https://ccc.bc.edu/content/bc-ccc/meet-members.html): BCCCC member directory with 400+ global corporate members.
- [Meet Our Members](https://ccc.bc.edu/content/bc-ccc/why-join/testimonials.html): Member testimonials and case studies from corporate partners.
- [Advisory Boards at BCCCC](https://ccc.bc.edu/content/bc-ccc/meet-members/advisory-boards.html): BCCCC advisory boards on inclusion, community involvement, and sustainability.

## Recognition & Awards

- [Innovation Awards](https://ccc.bc.edu/content/bc-ccc/bcconf26/innovation-awards.html): 2026 Innovation Awards honoring companies with social and environmental impact.

## CSR & ESG Resources

- [CSR & ESG Topics](https://ccc.bc.edu/content/bc-ccc/corporate-citizenship-topics.html): BCCCC resource library covering CSR/ESG dimensions and best practices.
- [Disclosure | ESG Reporting](https://ccc.bc.edu/content/bc-ccc/corporate-citizenship-topics/disclosure.html): ESG reporting and non-financial disclosure guidance for companies.
- [Environmental Sustainability](https://ccc.bc.edu/content/bc-ccc/corporate-citizenship-topics/environmental-sustainability.html): Environmental sustainability practices, trends, and competitive insights.
- [Inclusion & Belonging](https://ccc.bc.edu/content/bc-ccc/corporate-citizenship-topics/inclusion-belonging-engagement.html): Diversity, inclusion, and employee engagement resources for companies.
